CustomField.description: Counts how many Zone checkboxes have been marked for a Target.
CustomField.formula: IF( Zone1__c = TRUE,1,0) + IF( Zone2__c = TRUE,1,0) + IF( Zone3__c = TRUE,1,0) + IF( Zone4__c = TRUE,1,0) + IF( Zone5__c = TRUE,1,0) + IF( Zone6__c = TRUE,1,0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: The number of Zones marked for the Target.
CustomField.label: Zone Count
